svg.title: 2026/27 Physics school plan to Edexcel IAL course map
svg.desc: Editable seven-row map of the supplied Form 4 annual plan to selected Pearson Edexcel International Advanced Level Physics topics. The map describes planned objectives, not assessed mastery or complete IAL unit coverage. Current website interactives cover first-term mechanics and energy.

svg.text: School plan → Edexcel International A Level
Basis: the original school annual plan and Pearson IAL Physics 2018 specification, Issue 3 (July 2021).

g.aria-label: 1-10; Motion, forces, momentum and moments; Selected Unit 1 mechanics + Unit 4 momentum; Substantial topic match; Make graph skills and projectile coverage explicit.

text.tspan: Make graph skills and projectile coverage

g.aria-label: 11-17; Energy, work, power and resources; Unit 1 energy and efficiency; Substantial topic match; Develop angled-force work and quantitative applications.
21-26; Waves, light, sound and Doppler effect; Selected Unit 2 waves + Unit 5 Doppler; Partial match; Add interference, diffraction, polarisation and quantum physics.
27-31; Density, pressure and hydrostatics; Unit 1 density; pressure is additional foundation; Partial match; Add upthrust, viscosity and solid-material mechanics.
31-36; Conduction, convection and radiation; Foundation for thermal and radiation study; Additional foundation; Do not equate this with Unit 5 thermodynamics.

text.tspan: Do not equate this with Unit 5

g.aria-label: 36-42; Heat, internal energy and ideal gases; Unit 5 thermodynamics: 125, 128-130, 132; Substantial topic match; Verify derivations and specified practical methods.
Across year; 43-44; Practical work, review and examination; Units 3 and 6 practical skills need explicit evidence; Partial match; Teach planning, graphs, uncertainty and evaluation throughout.

svg.text: Substantial: main ideas are explicitly listed.
Partial: further IAL depth or evidence is needed.
Planned objectives do not certify assessed mastery.
16 first-term lessons cover mechanics and energy.
Later annual blocks are course destinations.
A topic title alone does not establish IAL depth,
Unit 1 materials; Unit 2 circuits and advanced
No complete IAL unit is certified by this map.

a.text: Pearson Edexcel IAL Physics · 2018 specification · Issue 3 (July 2021)

svg.text: Topic names are normalised for comparison; the source document’s equations are not silently corrected or replaced.
